title: Python Bindings: Calling C or C++ From Python
description: Learn how Python bindings let you call C or C++ code from Python, and compare tools like ctypes, CFFI, PyBind11, and Cython.
summary: Are you a Python developer with a C or C++ library you’d like to use from Python? If so, then Python bindings allow you to call functions and pass data from Python to C or C++ , letting you take advantage of the strengths of both languages.
